package.name: lucasCore
package.description: Builds LUCAS land-use and carbon models in ST-Sim from national datasets: FIA growth curves, CBM carbon parameters, spatial initial conditions, historical transitions and projections

column.name: EcodivisionFile
column.displayName: FIA Ecodivisions (dissolved; fields StrtmId, StrtmNm) - primary strata and model lattice

column.name: FiaConditionFile
column.displayName: FIA Condition Carbon and Merchantable Volume (USGS .Rds)

column.name: FiaDisturbanceFile
column.displayName: FIA Condition Disturbance and Treatment Codes (USGS .Rds)

column.name: FiaDataMartFolder
column.displayName: FIA DataMart Folder (state PLOT, COND, TREE csvs and FIADB_REFERENCE)

column.name: ForestTypeGroupFolder
column.displayName: USFS Forest Type Group Map Folder (NFCMS regional *_ForestType.tif)

column.name: TreeMapFolder
column.displayName: TreeMap Folder (TreeMap2016.tif and its .vat.dbf; forest type, stand age, site productivity)

column.name: LcmsFolder
column.displayName: USFS LCMS annual Change folder (year/*Change_year.tif; harvest, stages 6 and 10)

column.name: BurnProbabilityFile
column.displayName: Burn probability raster (fire method 2 default; FSim CONUS LF2020 270 m)

column.name: FpaFodFile
column.displayName: FPA-FOD fire occurrence geopackage (ignition density, fire method 2)

column.name: WuiFolder
column.displayName: SILVIS WUI v4 blocks (folder of state .gdb; stage 10)

column.name: NccpiFile
column.displayName: gNATSGO crop productivity NCCPI, 30 m (stage 10; blank = fetched for the fitting region from Planetary Computer)

column.name: ProjectionEndYear
column.displayName: Projection End Year (legacy: now in Projection > Run Settings)

column.name: StandAgeSource
column.formula1: 1:NASA CMS Forest Age 1990|2:TreeMap (FIA plot stand age)

column.name: LandCoverResampling
column.formula1: 1:Modal (most common 30 m class)|2:Area-matched (30 m class areas per secondary stratum unit)

column.name: SpatialTilesStrata
column.displayName: Spatial Tiles Strata (tiles are whole units of this level; every projection Target group uses it)

column.name: SourceId
column.displayName: Define the study area by (blank = all of CONUS)

column.name: SlopeSelectivity
column.displayName: Slope Selectivity (method 1: burned share by slope, from the fire record; method 2 uses the burn probability instead)

column.name: BurnProbabilityFile
column.displayName: Burn Probability Raster (method 2; blank = Data Sources: FSim CONUS 270 m)

column.name: C2FScenarioId
column.displayName: lucasFireC2F Result Scenario Id (method 3; a run or merge with the per-burn effects table)

column.name: ReferenceStartYear
column.displayName: Reference Period Start (blank = first historical transition year)

column.name: SpatialTiles
column.displayName: Spatial Multiprocessing Tiles (blank = the Build's; 1 = one job; 0 = automatic)

column.name: SpatialTilesStrata
column.displayName: Spatial Tiles Strata (tiles are whole units of this Build Options strata level; every Target group uses it)

column.name: HistoricalTypeShares
column.displayName: Weight a named group's types by their historical shares (default; off = the spatial allocation decides)

column.name: Method
column.formula1: 1:Fitted (regression on the historical record)|2:Rules (WUI and PAD weights)|3:None (random within its strata)

column.name: Surface
column.displayName: Surface (groups with the same name share one)

column.name: SourceClasses
column.displayName: Source Classes (NLCD codes a cell has the year before, e.g. 41|42|43; blank = not developed, water or ice)

column.name: EventClasses
column.displayName: Event Classes (NLCD codes the change goes to, e.g. 22|23|24; or LCMS:standrep, LCMS:partial, LANDFIRE:type)

column.name: Adjacency
column.displayName: Adjacency (more likely next to developed land, or to agriculture for agriculture events; updated in the run)

column.name: SizeDistribution
column.displayName: Size Distribution (historical patch sizes in ST-Sim; Auto = when patches span several model cells)

column.name: FitResolution
column.displayName: Fitting Resolution (m; 30 = native NLCD, coarser is faster)

column.name: BurnWindow
column.displayName: Leave Out Pixels Burned in the Last N Years (post-fire relabelling)

column.name: TestYears
column.displayName: Out-of-Sample Test Years (last N historical years; 0 = no test)

column.name: RegionSourceId
column.displayName: Fitting Region Kind (Spatial Allocation page; blank = the study area)

column.name: PatchSizes
column.displayName: Patch Sizes (master switch for the Size Distribution of each allocated group; off = none)

column.name: FlickerYears
column.displayName: Agriculture Flicker Window (years; drops events that undo a change of the last N years; 0 = off)

dataSheet.name: SuitabilityRegion
dataSheet.displayName: Suitability Fitting Region (blank = the study area)

column.name: Surface
column.displayName: Surface (blank = every surface without rows of its own)

column.name: Covariate
column.formula1: 1:Distance to developed land|2:Developed share within 1 km|3:Housing density (census decade)|4:Distance to roads|5:Slope|6:Elevation|7:Land cover|8:GAP status|9:County|10:Custom raster|11:Distance to agriculture|12:Agriculture share within 1 km|13:Crop productivity (NCCPI)|14:Forest owner type

column.name: File
column.displayName: Raster File (custom; resampled to the fitting grid)

column.name: Effect
column.displayName: Effect on Log-Odds (0 = the covariate's best value)

dataSheet.name: OutputPatchSize
dataSheet.displayName: Historical Patch Sizes (per Target group, model cells)

column.name: MaximumCells
column.displayName: Size Class (up to N model cells)

column.name: HistoricalScenarioId
column.displayName: Historical Run (result scenario Id in this library; blank = a continuous run)

column.name: Method
column.formula1: 1:Target (area by strata)|2:Probability (rate map by unit)|3:None (off in the projection)

column.name: SamplingSet
column.displayName: Sampling Set (groups in a set draw the same historical year)

column.name: ForestGrowthModel
column.displayName: Forest Growth (None = normal climate every year)

column.name: BranchToSnag
column.displayName: Branches: Share to Snag Branch (rest AG Fast)

column.name: FineRootToAG
column.displayName: Fine Roots: Share to AG Very Fast (rest BG Very Fast)

column.name: CoarseRootToAG
column.displayName: Coarse Roots: Share to AG Fast (rest BG Fast)

column.name: StemSnagFall
column.displayName: Stem Snag Fall (/yr, to AG Medium)

column.name: BranchSnagFall
column.displayName: Branch Snag Fall (/yr, to AG Fast)

column.name: Share
column.displayName: Share of Live Aboveground Wood Left as Snags

column.name: ExclusionYears
column.displayName: No Fire or Cutting Within (yr, blank = 30)

column.name: MinSnagsOwnRate
column.displayName: Min Snags: Own Snag Fall Rate (blank = 200)

column.name: MinPlotsConditionPools
column.displayName: Min Plots: Cell's Own Fit, Condition Pools (blank = 200)

column.name: ExclusionYears
column.displayName: No Fire or Cutting Within (yr, blank = Decay Calibration Settings)

column.name: FineRootShare
column.displayName: Fine Root Share of Roots (blank = Li et al. 2003)

column.name: HistoricalClearcutShare
column.displayName: Historical Cycles: Share Ended by Clearcut (blank = 0, all fire)

column.name: LastDisturbanceUnburned
column.displayName: Last Disturbance Where No Fire Perimeter (blank = clearcut)

column.name: Pool
column.formula1: 1:AG Very Fast|2:BG Very Fast|3:AG Fast|4:BG Fast|5:AG Medium|6:AG Slow|7:BG Slow|8:Snag Stem|9:Snag Branch

column.name: BaseDecayRate
column.displayName: Base Decay Rate (/yr at the reference temperature)

column.name: ShareEmitted
column.displayName: Share Emitted (rest to the next pool)

column.name: TransferToBGSlow
column.displayName: Transfer to BG Slow (/yr; AG Slow only)

column.name: DeadOrganicMatterModel
column.formula1: 4:FIA measured dead wood (down woody material and snags in mature stands)|3:CBM defaults (no calibration)|1:FIA condition pools (older option)|2:FIA condition pools, CBM-default soil (older option)

column.name: SoilCarbonModel
column.formula1: 1:gSSURGO (soil decay calibrated to its soil organic carbon)|2:CBM defaults (soil from the spin-up)

column.name: CurveScenarioId
column.displayName: Source Result Scenario Id (blank = the latest with curves; when copying)

column.name: LagYears
column.displayName: Fixed Lag Before Merchantable Volume (yr; blank = fitted per forest type)

column.name: MinPlotsLag
column.displayName: Minimum Plots to Fit a Forest Type's Own Lag (else its class lag)

column.name: Penalty
column.displayName: Pull Toward the Type's CONUS Curve (lambda)

column.name: MinPlotsEcodivision
column.displayName: Minimum Plots for an Ecodivision's Own Parameters

column.name: VolumeCapQuantile
column.displayName: Volume Outlier Cap (quantile within type group)

column.name: DownDeadCarbon
column.formula1: 1:Adjusted to field measurements (state factors, as the USGS tables)|2:As in FIADB (model, unadjusted)

column.name: MerchCarbonDensity
column.displayName: Merchantable Carbon Density (Mg C/m3; FIA wood + bark)

column.name: IneligibleArea
column.displayName: Area on Start-Year Classes with no Pathway (km2)

column.name: AgeBlockedArea
column.displayName: Area below the Pathway Minimum Age (km2)

dataSheet.name: OutputFireSize
dataSheet.displayName: Historical Fire Sizes (interagency perimeters, model cells)

column.name: MaximumCells
column.displayName: Size Class (up to N model cells)

dataSheet.name: OutputFireSlope
dataSheet.displayName: Fire Slope Selectivity (burned share by slope)

column.name: Dom
column.displayName: Mean Dead Organic Matter excl. Soil (Mg C/ha)

column.name: RunScenarioId
column.displayName: Run (result scenario Id in this library; blank = the newest ST-Sim result)

column.name: Baseline
column.displayName: Baseline (the run the others are compared with; none ticked = the first projection)

column.name: DomSoilChange
column.displayName: Dead wood, litter and soil change (Tg C)

column.name: LulcLoss
column.displayName: Mean losses to land-use and land-cover change: fire emissions and harvest (Tg C/yr)

column.name: Harvest
column.displayName: Forest harvest (km2, summed over the years)
